scope: Markato US cooperation coverage expansion through direct official PDP source recovery

decision.reason: No reviewed candidate is both US-commerce-ready and PDP-content-quality-ready. LIME passed commerce checks but extracted empty or size-only descriptions; OILUJ, KHUS KHUS, and Apiceuticals need source or extractor remediation first.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official Weebly PDP is still classified as channel_or_retailer and requires multi-offer validation.
brand_findings.next_step: Repair official Weebly source validation only if the extractor can reliably capture add-to-cart, fulfillment context, availability, and usable PDP content.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official English PDP remains EUR/Italy commerce, not US/USD.
brand_findings.next_step: Do not seed for US catalog unless a source-backed USD or US fulfillment path is found.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official PDP extracts content but commerce facts are AUD and fail US market switch.
brand_findings.next_step: Keep out of US PDP catalog until a USD/US commerce path is confirmed.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official PDP extracts content but commerce facts are AUD and fail US market switch.
brand_findings.next_step: Keep out of US PDP catalog until a USD/US commerce path is confirmed.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: English storefront remains EUR/Italy or Europe-oriented commerce; no confirmed US/USD path.
brand_findings.next_step: Do not seed for US catalog unless a source-backed USD or US fulfillment path is found.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official US/USD PDPs exist, but current extractor returns product_schema_missing.
brand_findings.next_step: Add or repair official WooCommerce-style PDP extraction, then re-run dry-run and avoid therapeutic disease claims.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official shop pages appear US-shippable and USD-selectable, but current extractor returns product_schema_missing.
brand_findings.next_step: Add or repair official WooCommerce-style PDP extraction, then re-run source-backed seed dry-run before any DB write.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Official PDP path remains Cloudflare/access gated and tested URL is travel-size, which is not a clean first coverage candidate.
brand_findings.next_step: Hold until a non-bundle, non-travel-size official PDP can be extracted without access blocks.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Cafe24 official English PDPs pass commerce facts, but extracted descriptions are empty or size-only, so public PDP quality would be thin.
brand_findings.next_step: Add Cafe24 detail-content extraction or source-backed content recovery before seed apply.

brand_findings.primary_blocker: Strict brand domain is Korean/KRW; official-linked Cafe24 English/USD subdomain needs policy acceptance before use.
brand_findings.next_step: Keep out of catalog unless official-linked Cafe24 subdomain is explicitly accepted as brand-owned for this program.

next_engineering_sequence: WooCommerce-style official PDP extraction for KHUS KHUS and Apiceuticals.
Weebly official source validation for OILUJ, gated on reliable commerce and content parsing.
Cafe24 detail-content extraction for LIME, with a hard hold on empty or size-only descriptions.
Re-run seed dry-runs, seed-content audit, production DB apply only for source-backed rows, then live PDP audit.
